    {"name": "asset_purpose_scope", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Purpose classification is largely redundant with asset_category_type (service->cloud_service, laptop->general_business track together) and some assignments (e.g. iPod touch -> cloud_service) are loose inferences. Moderate leverage."},
    {"name": "asset_brand_vendor", "analytical_usefulness": 0.5, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Vendor extraction from ci/description is a plausible new grouping axis (vendor-linked decline patterns) and mostly well-grounded, though 'cloud_provider' for a service is inferred rather than stated."},
    {"name": "processing_lag_indicator", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Lag between opened_at and processed_date is a strong candidate signal for decline; derivable from date columns. NULL/Unknown for nan processed_date is correct behaviour."},
    {"name": "department_origin", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.4, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Largely redundant with the existing 'department' column, and samples show values (sales, customer_support, product_management) with no supporting cue in the provided source text, suggesting invented assignment rather than grounded reading."},
    {"name": "source_id_validity", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Presence/absence of source_id is a plausible decline signal (missing identifiers -> rejection) and directly derivable from the source_id column."},
    {"name": "asset_specificity_level", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Vague vs specific description is a reasonable decline signal (vague expenses more likely rejected) and grounded in the description text, though specific/generic boundary is somewhat subjective."},
    {"name": "travel_associated_flag", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Binary travel flag derivable from category/description; a plausible grouping axis for policy-driven declines, though somewhat narrow and overlapping with category."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
  "source_groundedness": 0.8,
  "rationale": "Most added columns give genuine axes relevant to predicting declines (processing lag, source_id validity, specificity, travel), and their values are largely sound readings of the source text. Weak points: asset_purpose_scope duplicates asset_category_type, and department_origin both duplicates an existing original column and shows ungrounded, seemingly invented values in the samples. Overall the set offers real analytical leverage with mostly well-grounded values."}
